summary: Explains how Ethernet VPN (EVPN) provider edge routers can support hosts that use IGMP or MLD to join multicast groups. By running IGMP and MLD proxy procedures on those routers, multicast traffic can be handled efficiently across the EVPN network. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: When many people want the same TV show, it is wasteful to send each their own copy. This teaches the routers to learn who wants which show and pass along just one copy where needed.

questions: how does evpn handle igmp and mld
what is an igmp proxy in evpn
